name: Air Fryer Chicken Tikka with Basmati Rice and Yogurt Sauce

components.name: Chicken Tikka

ingredients.name: Raw boneless skinless chicken breast, large cubes
Tikka or garam masala spice blend

steps: Combine yogurt, lemon, oil, garlic, ginger, spices and salt. Coat raw cubed chicken and onion; refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Preheat air fryer to 200 C. Arrange chicken and onion loosely in the basket, leaving room between pieces; work in batches.
Cook approximately 12-16 minutes per batch, shaking halfway, until the thickest chicken pieces are at least 74 C.
Cool promptly, freeze later-week chicken-and-rice portions, and add chilled yogurt only at serving.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Rinse and simmer the 320 g dry basmati with 540 ml water and salt; leave covered to steam, then fluff.

components.name: Yogurt Sauce
steps: Stir Greek yogurt, lemon and coriander together without heating. Portion cooked chicken and rice into five containers, keeping cold sauce separate.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Measured UNHANGRY complete-meal adaptation of Skinnytaste chicken tikka; source demonstrates air-fryer alternative.
Planning: Secondary stovetop for rice. Marination minimum 1 hour. Air fryer needs multiple batches.
Freezer: chicken and rice; keep cold yogurt sauce separate
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
